summary: OpenAI's Codex now automatically performs security reviews of GitHub pull requests, posting findings inline as part of a broader initiative to apply models to code security.

mechanisms.reason: Codex is described as autonomously reviewing every pull request and posting findings, an agentic tool-use workflow substituting for manual security review.
mechanisms.quote: Codex can now perform a security review of every GitHub pull request, leaving findings inline.

practices.reason: Teams using Codex in their GitHub workflow now have an additional automated review step generating inline findings that needs to be incorporated into review processes.
